caption: The drawing depicts a large cylindrical jar with a lid, rendered in shades of brown. The jar has two small handles on either side near the top. The surface of the jar is predominantly a medium brown color, with a darker brown glaze that appears to have been poured over the top, creating dripping patterns that run down the sides. The lower part of the jar has a textured, mottled appearance, differentiating it from the smoother upper section. The lid is round and slightly domed, with a small knob in the center. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, and the artist's signature, "Annie B. Johnston," appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Pottery Jar with Lid
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
